SRC-339:R001.evidence: E-18489; the shipped hook now derives the action through declared_action(text, root) (extensions/adapters/zaicode/saipen-guard.py:535), so operator_origin's goal reservation for action in {goal, authorize-goal} is reachable from the ZAICODE adapter
SRC-339:R001.text: extensions/adapters/zaicode/saipen-guard.py must seal the operator's declared intent instead of hardcoding action = "continue": a goal request seals action "goal" and an explicit grant seals action "authorize-goal". saipen_engine/operator_origin.py reserves goal authority only for those two actions, so a guard that seals only "continue" makes persistent grants unreachable for a ZAICODE operator.
SRC-339:R001.verification: record:.saipen/evidence/focused-unit/c86c432efe87a4bc-20261026T184401369669Z.json sha256:a57e9def779b2c86c522b835294b750862bb9a1d08f32fef1f4224a2d0e8177c; test_t1933_zaicode_goal_seal.py TheHookSealsTheDeclaredIntent proves the seal is the declared action, not a constant: test_a_goal_objective_is_sealed_as_goal, test_a_canonical_goal_command_is_sealed_as_goal, test_a_host_aliased_goal_is_sealed_as_goal and test_a_grant_capsule_is_sealed_as_authorize_goal assert the exact action this hook hands the broker (goal / authorize-goal), while test_a_continuation_is_still_sealed_as_continue keeps the ordinary path unchanged; test_t1859_zaicode_seal.py test_the_registered_worker_is_this_hook_process_not_its_parent pins that the seal reaches the broker at all

SRC-339:R002.evidence: E-18489; declared_action() takes only the request_text the broker hashes into request_digest -- there is no intent field a caller could claim, so a model cannot manufacture a goal seal it was not handed
SRC-339:R002.text: The sealed action must be derived from the operator's own request text, not from model-supplied metadata: a prompt that is not a goal or an explicit grant still seals "continue", and an agent must not be able to manufacture a goal or authorize-goal seal by claiming one.
SRC-339:R002.verification: record:.saipen/evidence/focused-unit/c86c432efe87a4bc-20261026T184401369669Z.json sha256:a57e9def779b2c86c522b835294b750862bb9a1d08f32fef1f4224a2d0e8177c; test_t1933_zaicode_goal_seal.py TheHookSealsTheDeclaredIntent proves the action is read from the operator's own bytes: test_prose_that_mentions_goal_or_cc_is_never_a_goal refuses a sentence that merely talks about a goal, test_a_bare_goal_token_is_not_an_objective keeps the protocol's own use-line out of the seal, and test_the_pre_fix_hardcoded_action_is_refused_by_this_suite is the red control: the shipped one-line action = "continue" is replaced in a copy of the real hook and the suite then observes continue instead of goal; test_operator_ingress_matrix.py test_clause_d_agent_authored_text_cannot_impersonate and test_clause_e_model_created_task_files_cannot_forge_authority prove model-authored bytes carry no operator authority

SRC-339:R003.evidence: E-18489; the SRC-339 repair adds no new valve-clearing route: it changes which ACTION the existing broker proof declares, and RECONCILE_REAUTH_REQUIRED still refuses an agent CLI replay of a spent bounded run
SRC-339:R003.text: The safety valve must keep working: hitting goal_tickets must still trip continuation_authority to operator_required with safety_valve_mode hard_wait, and an agent CLI replay must still be refused with RECONCILE_REAUTH_REQUIRED. Renewal requires fresh operator carrier provenance, never an agent call.
SRC-339:R003.verification: record:.saipen/evidence/focused-unit/c86c432efe87a4bc-20261026T184401369669Z.json sha256:a57e9def779b2c86c522b835294b750862bb9a1d08f32fef1f4224a2d0e8177c; test_reconcile_valve.py test_tickets_at_the_cap_refuses_even_when_counters_agree, test_waves_at_the_cap_trips_independently, test_a_state_already_stating_the_pause_needs_no_repair and test_the_counters_are_never_tidied_by_this_rule prove the trip condition is unchanged and the counters are never silently cleared; test_t1729_operator_gate.py test_requested_resume_cannot_override_a_computed_budget_stop and test_limitation_acceptance_preserves_a_computed_budget_stop prove a request cannot override a computed stop; {HOME_VALVE} test_consumer_project_keeps_the_bounded_operator_gate proves the consumer project still demands the operator, and test_protocol_home_cc_clears_the_valve_without_an_operator_carrier scopes the only exception to the protocol home itself; test_t1933_zaicode_goal_seal.py test_an_unsealed_prompt_spends_nothing proves no engine runs without a broker seal

SRC-339:R004.evidence: E-18489; broker_worker._worker accepts a verifier only BELOW the registered worker and register_worker refuses pid == proof[host_pid], so the spend must run from the hook -- the agent's shell is the hook's sibling and could never verify its own seal
SRC-339:R004.text: Worker registration must make the sealed origin recognizable: the registered worker process must match the ancestry the broker requires, so a seal issued by the guard is recognized and spent exactly once rather than refused as unproven.
SRC-339:R004.verification: record:.saipen/evidence/focused-unit/c86c432efe87a4bc-20261026T184401369669Z.json sha256:a57e9def779b2c86c522b835294b750862bb9a1d08f32fef1f4224a2d0e8177c; test_t1933_zaicode_goal_seal.py test_the_engine_runs_below_the_worker_that_registered_the_proof asserts the engine process that spends the seal is a CHILD of the worker row the broker accepted (ran.parent_pid == registered.worker); test_a_sealed_goal_runs_the_goal_entry_from_the_hook and test_a_sealed_grant_runs_goal_authorize_on_the_exact_bytes prove the sealed entry is actually spent once, from the hook; {HOOK} test_the_registered_worker_is_this_hook_process_not_its_parent and test_the_pre_fix_registration_is_refused_by_this_suite prove the host pid is refused as a worker and the hook's own pid is the accepted one

SRC-339:R005.evidence: E-18489; every goal/grant spend in the hook is inside `if sealed`, and `sealed` requires a broker-issued proof PLUS a successful register_operator_worker, so no budget moves without a native operator carrier
SRC-339:R005.text: No budget may be renewed or extended without a native operator carrier. A direct CLI call by an agent, a replayed message, and a forged or copied seal all fail closed.
SRC-339:R005.verification: record:.saipen/evidence/focused-unit/c86c432efe87a4bc-20261026T184401369669Z.json sha256:a57e9def779b2c86c522b835294b750862bb9a1d08f32fef1f4224a2d0e8177c; test_t1933_zaicode_goal_seal.py TheSafetyValveStillHolds proves the repair opens no unsealed path: test_an_unsealed_prompt_spends_nothing drives the hook with a HOST_PROVENANCE_UNAVAILABLE broker answer and observes zero engine runs, and test_the_hook_still_requires_a_broker_sealed_origin_to_spend_anything asserts the spend is gated on sealed; {AUTHORITY} test_real_looking_model_request_has_no_operator_preemption, test_identical_trusted_bytes_have_different_authority and test_duplicate_captured_model_bytes_cannot_gain_carrier_authority prove copied or replayed bytes carry no carrier authority; {GATE} test_plain_model_decision_does_not_authorize_a_gate and test_missing_or_wrong_source_digest_cannot_grant_authority prove a forged or wrong-digest capsule grants nothing

SRC-339:R006.evidence: E-18489; this Work added no hand-edit route: the SRC-339 source itself offers a manual goal_tickets edit as an operator-side alternative, it was recorded as a non-goal (R006) rather than implemented, and no file in the repair writes .saipen/STATE.md directly
SRC-339:R006.text: Manually editing .saipen/STATE.md to clear a tripped goal_tickets counter is not a supported repair and must not be implemented as one. The protocol's own canonical reauthorization route is the only sanctioned path.
